overview: Hypothyroidism is a health condition that requires individualized medical assessment. Symptoms, causes, and treatment vary by person — consult a qualified doctor in India for diagnosis and a care plan tailored to your history and local guidelines.
symptoms: From a clinical perspective, hypothyroidism is an endocrine disease in which the thyroid gland does not produce enough thyroid hormones.
From a clinical perspective, it can cause a number of symptoms, such as poor ability to tolerate cold, extreme fatigue, muscle aches, constipation, slow heart rate, depression...
